newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SYDNEY CASINO SEES NO SALES RISE UNTIL DEC.
newsitem.headline: SYDNEY CASINO SEES NO SALES RISE UNTIL DEC.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd said on Thursday it was operating at capacity at peak periods and was therefore unlikely to increase revenues until it moved out of its temporary buildings and into its permanent casino site in December.

"We are operating at capacity in peak periods so given the limitations of the temporary casino, we would not anticipate any material increase in revenues until we move into Star City," Sydney Harbour Casino Dick Warburton said in a statement.

Earlier, Sydney Harbour Casino posted a half year net loss of A$7.34 million, after an abnormal loss before tax of A$42.99 linked to the interest costs and pre-opening costs relating to the permanent Star City casino.
Operating profit fell to A$32.45 million in the half year from A$33.8 million profit in the corresponding half a year earlier.
